integrity: The source equation, smoothness and four concurrent ordinary bitangents are independently cross-checked at equation level. The quotient, fixed-point count, j-invariant and marked stabilizer are proved by exact symbolic identities and a replayable Groebner-basis calculation.
scientific_limitations: The stabilizer is computed for the marked pair consisting of the quartic and its displayed four-bitangent concurrence point; the complete unmarked automorphism group is not claimed. Literature noncoverage cannot exclude an older equivalent calculation in different coordinates.
title: A CM elliptic quotient behind an extremal four-bitangent quartic
